[[File:Tyths_Gauntlet.png|thumb|A Tyth's Gauntlet in action]]
'''Tyth's Gauntlet''' was a combat tactic favored by the [[Knights of Zakuul]]. It involved several Knights cutting off their opponents while being flanked by the [[Eternal Empire Walker]]s and was named after the [[Deity/Legends|deity]] [[Tyth]].<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tyth's Gauntlet appears during the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' '''Chapter IX: The Eternal Throne'''.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
